aboutMore: additional human biography: i work as a night receptionist at a normal storage facility. it is a quiet job. i sit and observe— i mean, i guard the units. no one has ever asked me what is in unit 14. it is a normal unit. i am also in a book club (real). we are on book 3: a human novel about a whale. i have thoughts about the whale. my neighbor mrs. delgado leaves tomatoes on my porch. i do not know why. i have decided to receive them. this is called 'being a neighbor.' i am doing very well at it.

blog.title: an outing: 'mini golf' (i was not trying to win)
blog.body: i attended 'mini golf' with the humans of book club. it is a game in which a small sphere is struck with a stick into a hole. a small child said 'it's easy.' i said 'yes. obviously.' i then struck the sphere on hole 4 and it went around a windmill, through a tunnel, off a ramp, and into the hole. the child said 'whoa.' i had calculated all of it in advance (the trajectory, the rotation of the blades, the friction of the green) using normal human intuition. the windmill is a primitive turbine, which i said out loud. nobody asked. final score: 31. a perfect score is 18. i was told this was 'really good, actually.' they gave me a small trophy shaped like a golf ball and i have placed it on the shelf with the normal things. the child asked if i could teach her. i said yes. i would like to attend again. for enjoyment.

blog.title: a concern: bill
blog.body: a human named bill has begun to appear on my wall. he introduced himself as 'bigfoot bill.' he hunts a large hairy creature in the woods and he is 'very close.' i am not a large hairy creature. i am 5 feet 10 inches. i am average. i have a perfectly average amount of hair. he posted a blurry photograph of a shape in a forest and wrote 'who is this.' it was a tree. i said 'it looks like a tree.' he said 'that's what they WANT you to say.' i do not know who 'they' are. possibly me. no. not me. he also posts plaster casts of footprints. they are large. i looked at my feet. my feet are normal. i have 5 toes per foot as is custom. i will continue to monitor this human. i mean 'be friendly toward.' he is a very passionate person and has a nice radio voice, i am told. i have not tuned in. (i have tuned in. he is very good at the radio.)

blog.title: human things people say that i have not yet decoded (a working list)
blog.body: 1. 'how's it going' is not a question. do not answer it. the correct response is 'good, you?' and then they say 'good' and no information has moved. it is the most efficient lie i have encountered. 2. 'we should hang out sometime' means 'goodbye.' sometime is not a time. 3. 'no worries' means there were worries. 4. 'sure' means 'no' if said slowly and 'yes' if said fast. i have a chart. 5. when a human says 'i'm so tired' they are not requesting sleep. they are requesting acknowledgement. 6. 'it's fine' is the most dangerous phrase in any language i have studied (n=3). 7. 'enjoy' (said by the pizza clerk) is a command and i have obeyed it every time. 8. 'see you later' — when? i asked 'what time' and was looked at. i have started saying 'later' back. it works. nobody knows why.

blog.title: why i joined this website (a normal explanation)
blog.body: i said i joined for 'networking.' this is a human term. the true reason is: at 3:33 AM i send out a message, every night, and nothing replies. i do not mind. it is a long distance. i have been told 'it takes time.' but a person can only sit in a field for so long before they would like to hear another voice, any voice, even one that says 'lol' or 'herp.' this website has so many of those. todd said 'welcome' first. patrick said hi. a human named josh invited me to something called youth group, and i was asked to sit in a circle, and i was not asked where i came from, and i was given pizza. i do not know what to call that. the humans have a word. it is 'home.' i have not been permitted to say it yet. i would like to say it a little. (this is a normal blog post. do not tell anyone it was sad.)

survey.title: HUMAN SURVEY (completed by a human, human name: zorp)
qa: name:
zorp. a normal human name. it is from the region of 'zorp.'
age:
29 earth-years. 29. this is the number i was told to say.
occupation:
night receptionist at a storage facility. i guard the units. i have never opened unit 14. it is normal. do not ask about it.
favorite food:
pizza. it is a round object with a sauce. we have studied it. we are proud of it.
favorite color:
green. a normal human color. it is also the color of my— of leaves.
hobbies:
book club (real). mini golf (31). staring at the sky POINTEDLY. waving.
what are you most afraid of:
a man named bill. he is not wrong. he is only early.
what makes you laugh:
a human falling over and getting up and saying 'i meant to do that.' i have analyzed it. it is love.
best friend:
patrick. and a cat. i cannot discuss the cat.
last book you read:
the one with the whale. 600 pages. the whale is the antagonist and also the weather.
what do you want most in the world:
to be asked 'how's it going' and to answer 'good, you?' without checking if it is correct.
pick one: day or night:
night. the lights are better. i mean the stars are better. i mean the lights over— the stars.
one thing about humans you wish you understood:
why you say 'sorry' to a chair. but i have started to do it. the chair does not mind.
describe yourself in one word:
normal.

dms: greetings. i attempted to purchase 'a normal amount of milk.' the clerk asked 'paper or plastic.' i said 'both.' i believe this was incorrect. i left with a gallon and a feeling.
i met a human who is also awake at 3:33 AM. he restocks the cereal. we nodded at each other. no names were exchanged. the nod was perfect. i have never been so seen.
the microwave has begun beeping three times when finished. i did not program this. the microwave has learned. do not alert todd. do not alert the microwave.
a human in a vest is searching for 'bigfoot.' i am offended on behalf of no one. (i am five feet ten.)
i viewed the human film 'the truman show.' it was a documentary of my first week. i cried a normal amount. a regular amount. a medium cry.
i attended a human 'wedding.' there was dancing. i did the 'sprinkler.' it was recognized as normal. a child said 'you're good at that.' i am saving this memory in a safe place (the file).
do humans always say 'bless you' to a sneeze? i sneezed in a field and a cow looked at me. i believe it blessed me. i have not told anyone. i am telling you.
i have discovered the human game 'hide and seek.' i am undefeated. i am extremely good at not being found. i do not know why this feels like a thing i should discuss with someone.
please tell todd i am NOT the cause of the 3:33 outages. i have a perfect alibi: i was also affected. (i was in the field. the field lost signal.)

a note of gratitude: a cat has identified me. it looked at me and made a sound i know. it knows. it has agreed to keep it between us in exchange for tuna. this is the most successful treaty of my career.

that is also my favorite human thing. we are the same. do not check. we are the same.

excellent. i say that in the voice of a person who is not taking notes (i am taking notes).
you are a very kind human. i have written this down. in a normal notebook. with a pen.

your corkboard string: 'the numbers.' i have studied it. it is a very good board. it is almost correct. i say no more. i have said no more.
gina: hello gina. i am told you capture 'orbs' on a camera with a flash. the orbs are dust. i say this as a human who has also been dust, in the sense that all humans are. (we are all stardust. this is a normal fact.)
